Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single Godot character portrait, full-bleed vertical 2:3 illustration, 1024x1536.
Input image 1 is the ORIGINAL Onmyoji: The Card Game (阴阳师百闻牌) character card, used ONLY as the authoritative reference for identity, costume, silhouette, props, color palette and painted style. Create a fresh detailed redraw of that exact reference character, faithfully following its visible design. The attached printed card frame, name, numbers, symbols and text are not part of the illustration and must all be omitted.
Style/medium: match the original reference's fine Japanese fantasy ink outlines, clear planar cel-painted forms, restrained mineral pigment colors and subtle washi paper texture. Keep its illustrated proportions; no photorealism, no shiny generic 3D/gacha aesthetic.
Composition: the exact visible character, paired figures, puppet or mount grouping in the reference; head in the upper quarter, face clear and large enough to read as a small game portrait, body and identifying props inside the central 75%. Maintain the original pose and mood where practical, extending only its background into a vertical frameless painting.
Anatomy: coherent face perspective, natural eye alignment, distinct nose and mouth, clean jaw silhouette, well-formed hands, correct separate limbs. Hair may overlap as in the original but must not accidentally fuse with facial features.
Constraints: no character redesign, no new costume or unreferenced accessories; no letters, numbers, card border, interface, logo or watermark. If the source is ambiguous, retain the visible form instead of inventing details.
Subject-specific reference invariants: 椒图: Blue-black-haired aquatic girl in teal red kimono, purple blue mermaid tail and a large decorated shell-shaped canopy with beads; preserve shell and tail.
For paired or mounted references, keep exactly the original figures, no reduction to one generic character. For costume variants, use only this attached specific variant, never another skin.

Critical removal: NEVER reproduce the printed affiliation emblem from the boundary between illustration and card text. No blue triple-swirl circular icon, red three-flame icon, purple three-arrow triangle icon or green three-leaf circle icon anywhere. They are NOT a magical effect or costume ornament. Draw ordinary painted background beneath the body and feet. Preserve genuine character design, original pose and props. Only the painting, without ANY printed card UI emblem.
